---
title: "11 - Time-series and missing data"
format:
  html:
    toc-expand: 4
---

Learning objectives for this week:

- Understand the unique characteristics of time-series data and how this affects data science analyses
- Explore some feature engineering techniques for time-series data, such as time lagging, rolling windows and cyclic features
- Perform a rolling forecast horizon to validate machine learning models for time-series
- Understand types of missing data: Missing Completely at Random (MCAR), Missing at Random (MAR) and Missing Not at Random (MNAR)
- Explore some data imputation techniques for missing data and understand when to use them
